KOL Management · The Originals

Three campaigns. Real budgets. Results that stuck.

Chief Manager at The Originals — a KOL agency built on the belief that FOMO only works when the narrative isn't paid for, but original. I source context-specific accounts, manage their KPIs, and craft the content that moves protocols from unknown to inevitable.

Services

Every service offered here is backed by experience — not theory. These are things I have done, am doing, and do well.

01

KOL Campaign Management

End-to-end campaign execution — from strategy through sourcing through delivery. KPIs tied to outcomes that matter: volume, narrative adoption, and follower growth that holds.

02

Ambassador Management

Structured ambassador programs that convert community members into protocol evangelists. Built on the Bethel model: performance-first selection, clear KPIs, and leadership layers that scale. Led as Ambassador Lead — understands the role from the inside out.

03

Talent Acquisition

Spotting accounts that can sell without sounding sold. The difference between a KOL who moves a narrative and one who just posts it is something you learn by doing this work long enough — and knowing what organic actually looks like.

04

Twitter / X Thread Writing

Narrative-first threads built for crypto-native audiences. Every tweet earns its place. No fluff, no staircase formatting — just clean story that moves from attention to conviction.

05

Long-form Articles & Blog Posts

Publication-ready editorial for protocols, DAOs, and Web3 platforms. Deep research, sharp angles, prose that reads like a human wrote it — because one did.

06

Editorial Content Strategy

Positioning, angle development, and content direction for projects that want their story told — not just their features listed. The difference between being remembered and being scrolled past.
